next_actions.task: Implement trust score v1 (contract 0.7.0 ProviderScore, ProviderScoreBreakdown, ScoreComponent). 2026-11-18 progress (branch p3.s13-one-trust-score, stacked on p3.s12-one-decline-silence, not merged): TrustScore (backend/src/main/java/app/plug/request/TrustScore.java) computes the owner's v1 rules (decisions.P3.S13-trust-score-v1): completion = completed jobs / confirmed bookings whose outcome is known (amended 2026-11-23: a job still in progress does not count; asker cancellations leave the denominator; release or timeout before confirming is not a booking), null below 3; with no provider cancel or no-show recorded yet, completion is 100 whenever it has evidence; responsiveness = answered / (answered + silent), open matches inside respond_by excluded, null below 5, from one SQL query that reproduces the inbox MatchStatus (RequestService.responsiveness now delegates to it, no N+1); reliability always null, basis 0; standing 100 active or 0 suspended, basis = days since the profile was created or standing last changed; value = weighted mean of non-null components (completion 25, reliability 15, responsiveness 10, standing 10), no recency weighting. Reads (GET /v1/providers/me, POST /v1/providers/skills, admin) compute it live, with score_breakdown.updated_at = the last recompute (else the profile's created_at) so two reads are identical (tools/phase2-live.mjs checks GET /v1/providers/me equals the setup response); every event recomputes it in its own transaction and writes provider_scores (completed_jobs, response_rate 0..1 once 5 matches exist, trust_score only once 3 jobs are completed, updated_at) and a score_history row (old/new value, completed_jobs, components, cause, at) when anything but standing's day count moved. Causes: job_completed, reservation_confirmed, reservation_released, reservation_timed_out, reservation_canceled, offer_sent, match_declined, silence_detected (the worker marks each unanswered match past respond_by once, request_matches.silence_checked_at, in its own SKIP LOCKED transaction), standing_changed. ProviderProfile now carries score_breakdown and standing. Migration V13 (expand only): provider_profiles.standing and standing_changed_at, provider_scores.updated_at, score_history, request_matches.silence_checked_at, two partial indexes. Example added: contracts/examples/p3-provider-profile-scored.json (no schema change). Tests: TrustScoreTest (10 database tests, fixed mutable clock). Not done: recency weighting, per-skill scores, the nightly recompute named in manual 19A.5, Verified (12C.4), anti-gaming (12C.5). 2026-11-23 review fixes: responsiveness counts a reply as answered only by respond_by (a late offer or decline is silence; resolves the P3.S12 late-decline question); reliability basis = the confirmed jobs completion rests on (contract ScoreComponent.basis); the in-progress denominator fix; contract 0.7.3 (no schema change) records the rules, corrects p3-admin-providers.json and the admin fixtures, and adds providers.decline/suspended.json and providers.reservation/suspended.json.

next_actions.task: Implement the New provider state and provider standing (contract 0.7.0 ProviderStanding, listProviders, setProviderStanding). 2026-11-18 progress (same branch as P3.S13): New is ProviderScore state new below 3 completed jobs, stored as trust_score null; MatchService ranks a provider with no trust score on a neutral 50 and no response rate on 0.5, never 0 (documented in MatchService). GET /v1/admin/providers (cursor/limit like the other admin pages, newest first, audited admin.read providers) and POST /v1/admin/providers/{user_id}/standing ({standing active|suspended, reason 3..300}, nothing else) behind requests_v2: admin scope with a completed second factor (SecurityConfiguration), then an active staff account with role owner (403 otherwise, checked before validation); 404 for an unknown or malformed user_id; 400 required or invalid on reason, invalid on standing, extra field or non-object body; returns AdminProvider, Cache-Control no-store; audited as provider.standing_changed with reason '<standing>: <reason>' in audit_events. Suspending, in one transaction, locks the provider's requests in id order, withdraws their live offers (not a confirmed booking's), releases their pending reservations (the asker's request returns to ranked or expires not_confirmed), sets standing, standing_changed_at and accepting false, and recomputes the score (standing 0). A suspended provider is never matched or notified, and sendProviderOffer, declineMatch and answerReservation return 403 forbidden. Reinstating sets standing active (standing 100) and leaves accepting false until the provider turns it on through POST /v1/providers/skills; withdrawn offers stay withdrawn. All three 'shortcut: standing not stored' sites are replaced. 2026-11-23 security-review fixes: setProviderStanding locks the provider's users row first (the lock offer, decline and answer take first), so a racing action either finishes before the suspension or is refused; MatchService re-reads standing and accepting under the candidate lock and keeps only those rows.

next_actions.task: Implement decline-versus-silence tracking (contract 0.7.1 declineMatch). 2026-11-17 progress (branch p3.s12-one-decline-silence, stacked on p3.s11-one-provider-offers, not merged): POST /v1/providers/me/inbox/{match_id}/decline behind requests_v2 and provider_inbox (404 with the flag off). 401 without a session or for an inactive account, 403 for other scopes; 429 with Retry-After past 30 declines per window per caller, counted before any lookup; 404 for a malformed, missing or another provider's match_id. Body is optional MatchDecline: no body or {} or {reason: busy|too_far|price|not_my_skill|other}; anything else is 400 (reason invalid, or body invalid for an extra field or a non-object). A decline writes request_matches.declined_at, decline_reason and replied_at at the same instant and returns InboxItem status declined; declining again returns the first item unchanged (first reason and time kept). 409 request_closed (field match_id) after this provider offered or when the request is no longer submitted/routed/awaiting_responses/ranked; an offer after a decline is 409 request_closed (sendProviderOffer now checks declined_at instead of a reply with no offer). Migration V12 (expand only): request_matches.declined_at and decline_reason (CHECK enum; a reason only with a decline; replied_at = declined_at). InboxItem declined now comes from declined_at. Silence: a match with no reply at respond_by (notified_at + 5 minutes) is expired; for an expired request the end time is the earlier of its deadline and updated_at, so a request still running after the window counts as silence and one that ended inside it is closed (S10 treated every expired request as closed). RequestService.responsiveness(provider) returns the facts the score rests on: answered (an offer or a decline, replied_at set) and silent (MatchStatus expired); closed, not_chosen and open count as neither. Nothing reads it yet. Not done, left for P3.S13: the responsiveness value itself (manual 12C.2 gives replied / matched x 100, but the minimum evidence before a null value is not defined), ProviderProfile.score_breakdown, the score-change log, and whether provider_scores.response_rate (used by match ranking) should be fed from these facts. Suspended standing is still not stored (no 403 suspended). The decline reason is stored but not yet used to tune matching.

next_actions.task: Implement POST /v1/requests/{request_id}/offers (contract 0.7.1 sendProviderOffer) for in-app provider offers; the SMS path waits for P3.S5. 2026-11-17 progress (branch p3.s11-one-provider-offers, not merged): route behind requests_v2 and provider_inbox (404 with the flag off; a POST beside the GET offers handler is now 404 instead of 405/500). Caller must be a provider matched to the request: never matched, nonexistent, malformed or the asker's own request are the same 404. Idempotency-Key required, same key and body replay the first 201, another body with that key is idempotency_key_reused; the replay runs before the limiter, which allows 10 offers per window per caller before any lookup (429 with Retry-After). Body checked against ProviderOfferCreate (additionalProperties false, price 500..50000, currency USD else unsupported, RFC 3339 available_at, note 1..140). Server checks: over_budget, outside_window (past, more than 7 days ahead, after needed_by), contact_in_note on the NFKC-normalized note (seven or more digits with any separators, Unicode digits, emails including 'at ... dot' spellings, URLs, any word.tld and spaced or spelled '.com'; '2 chairs', '$30', '3:30 pm' and '15 min' pass; spelled-out numbers are left to moderation). A note with control, bidi or zero-width characters is 400 invalid; available_at must be RFC 3339 with seconds and an offset. 409 already_offered (a second offer, enforced by a partial unique index on portal offers whose violation maps to 409), request_closed (not submitted/routed/awaiting_responses/ranked, or the match has replied_at with no offer, the decline stand-in until P3.S12). The Offer: source portal, truth_label confirmed, observed_at now, no place, note, distance_m from the match rounded to 100 m, expires_at = available_at + 15 minutes (owner decision 2026-11-17; written into contract 0.7.2 by a separate PR). Sending sets request_matches.replied_at. Migration V11 (expand only): place_id nullable for portal only, note and distance_m columns, truth_label confirmed and source portal allowed, seed offers stay estimated. Offer reads use LEFT JOINs so portal offers list for the asker and show in the inbox as offered; the next worker pass ranks an awaiting_responses request once every seed replied and an offer is live; the asker can select it and only the provider's confirm books it (tested end to end). Not done: suspended standing (not stored, no 403 suspended), truth_label aging from observed_at (a portal offer stays confirmed until it expires), the iOS offer screen (P3.S16), SMS offers (P3.S5). Seed offers still carry no provider and can never be confirmed.

booking_ref has 20 bits and is not unique (contract: not secret). The P3.S5 SMS CONFIRM must find a reservation by sender and pending status, never by booking_ref alone.

Reservation timeout and completion run lazily on read and in RequestWorker (fixedDelay 1s, single process). With the worker off and no reads, a pending reservation stays pending past confirm_by until the next touch.

Provider standing (contract 0.7.0 ProviderProfile.standing, active or suspended) is not stored, so answerReservation and sendProviderOffer cannot refuse a suspended provider and treats every provider as active. Add the column and the check when the admin standing route (POST /v1/admin/providers/{user_id}/standing) is built.

P3.S10 hourly cap: MatchService.notify locks the candidate provider_profiles rows (FOR NO KEY UPDATE, id order) inside the worker transaction, and RequestService.workOnce routes up to 20 requests in one transaction. Across requests the lock order is not global, so two workers can deadlock. Latent while one process runs the worker; fix before scaling out (one transaction per request, or lock the union of candidate providers once per pass).

Truth labels are not aged from observed_at (manual 11.2): an in-app (portal) offer stays confirmed until it expires, which can be up to 7 days and 15 minutes after it was sent. Add server-side aging before portal offers reach real users.

P3.S12: silence on an expired request uses the earlier of its deadline and updated_at as its end. A ranked request whose offers all ran out is expired only when the worker or a read next sees it, so if the worker lags past a provider's reply window that match is counted as silence although the request had already ended.

P3.S13: response_rate in provider_scores now feeds match ranking (it was always null, so 0.5). A provider below 5 matches still ranks on 0.5 and a New provider on trust 50, by design (P3.S14); both are neutral defaults, not evidence.

P3.S13: the manual (19A.5) also names a nightly recompute; there is none. Scores move only on the listed events, and standing's day count is computed on read, so nothing stale is shown, but provider_scores.updated_at is the last event, not the last night.
P3.S13: GET /v1/admin/providers computes each row's score live (about four queries a provider, at most 100 a page). Fine for the console now; store the breakdown if pages grow.

P3.S14: offer, decline and answer can no longer race a suspension (users-row lock), but a selection by the asker that races it can still open a pending reservation on the suspended provider's offer (the offer was read before the suspension committed). The provider cannot confirm it (403) and it times out at confirm_by; locking the offer's profile in selectOffer would close it.
P3.S14: the free-text suspension reason is stored only in audit_events.reason (never in a log line). It is staff-written but may mention a customer; treat audit_events as Sensitive when exporting.

P3.S13: completion counts only bookings whose outcome is known, and the only recorded outcome is completed (no provider cancel or no-show after confirming exists yet), so completion is 100 whenever it has evidence. It becomes informative when a provider-side failure is recorded.
P3.S14: reinstating a provider leaves accepting false; nothing tells them to turn it back on yet (iOS shows accepting from GET /v1/providers/me).

P3.S12/P3.S13: a decline is still accepted after respond_by while the request is open, but it now counts as silence for responsiveness (owner rule: silence is no reply by respond_by). The inbox still shows it as declined.
P3.S14: the matching re-check under the candidate lock (standing and accepting) has no deterministic race test; it is covered by reading and by the suspended-is-not-matched test.

P3.S13-trust-score-v1.title: Trust score v1 and standing, honest v1 rules
rules: Completion = completed jobs / confirmed bookings for that provider. A booking counts as confirmed once the provider confirmed it; asker cancellations are excluded from the denominator because the schema has no cancel actor; provider release or timeout before confirmation is not a booking. Evidence minimum 3 confirmed bookings, else null.
Responsiveness = answered (offer or decline) / (answered + silent); open matches still inside respond_by are excluded. Evidence minimum 5 matches, else null.
Reliability = null with basis 0 until on-time and price evidence exists (Phase 5 reviews). Never faked.
Standing = 100 while active, 0 while suspended; basis = days since the provider profile was created or last standing change.
Overall value = weighted mean over non-null components, completion 25, reliability 15, responsiveness 10, standing 10 (customer_rating null until Phase 5). No recency weighting in v1.
Fewer than 3 completed jobs is ProviderScore state new with completed_jobs and no value, never 0; match ranking keeps a neutral default for New.
Every score change is logged with its cause in score_history. Standing control is owner-only through listProviders and setProviderStanding.
P3.S13-trust-score-v1.amended: 2026-11-23: a confirmed booking counts in the completion denominator only once its outcome is known (completed); one still in progress does not. Suspending also sets accepting false and reinstating leaves it false (fixture admin.providers.standing/suspended.json). Asker cancellations stay out of the denominator as decided on 2026-11-17: cancel clears confirmed_at, so a confirmed-then-canceled booking cannot be told apart and no cancel actor is stored.
